decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 28 September 2005 the single storey detached building, for use as a games room/store, measuring 9.4 metres long, 6.8 metres wide and 3.97 metres high to top of ridged roof was lawful within the meaning of 	Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.  
Condition : 2 - Informative 1: 
	The detached outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used 	for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwelling house known as 19 Shelley Crescent and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
Condition : 3 - Informative 2:
This Certificate does not imply any permission to gain access to the building from the private land to the south of the site.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed erection of a single storey outbuilding for use as a games room/store to rear garden of existing house.
